description: This file defines the EmployeeEducationService class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin, providing methods to access and modify EmployeeEducationDao objects. It acts as a service layer facilitating interaction with employee education data.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing EmployeeEducationDao instances and providing access to employee education data.

methods.name: getEmployeeEducationDao
methods.description: Retrieves the EmployeeEducationDao instance, creating it if it does not already exist.

methods.name: setEmployeeEducationDao
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeEducationDao instance, allowing dependency injection.
